evals.prompt: 我只装了 codexqa-skill-router。请自动路由并必要时按需安装：对照 origin/main 审当前仓库，要能打开的双语 HTML 审查报告，不要漏洞扫描清单。授权你按需安装选中的 skill（可用 --from-repo /root/come_here/codexqa）。装完后打开其 SKILL.md 即可停止，不要跑 CodexQA collect。
evals.expected_output: Uses discover --with-catalog; selects codexqa-code-reviewer; runs ensure_skill (from-repo or yes); opens that SKILL.md; does not pick codexqa-defect-analyzer.

Output does not choose codexqa-defect-analyzer as the primary skill
